ESSENTIAL QUESTION

How were Italy and Germany made into nation-states, and what part did leaders play compared with larger forces?

MODULE OBJECTIVES
1
Describe what the Congress of Vienna tried to build and why it lasted.
2
Explain how liberalism and nationalism challenged the settlement of 1815.
3
Evaluate why the revolutions of 1848 spread so quickly and failed so quickly.
4
Describe how Italy was unified under Piedmont, through diplomacy, war, and volunteers.
5
Explain how Bismarck used three wars to unite Germany under Prussia.
6
Evaluate the roles of leaders, armies, and underlying forces in building the two nation-states.
